description: Read up to 50 stored posts from a collection owned by the signed-in user, optionally filtered by matched crypto or prediction markets. Rechecks current stream and target access. A page can be empty with nextToken when posts are inaccessible; continue with the returned cursor.

limit.description: Maximum posts to return in this page

matchFilter.description: Keep only posts matching at least one enabled flag (crypto, polymarket, kalshi); omit for all posts. Scans at most 500 stored posts per call, so continue with nextToken

crypto.description: Include posts with a Binance, Bybit or Hyperliquid ticker, or matching cryptoKeywords

cryptoKeywords.description: Whole words matched case-insensitively in post text; applies only with crypto: true

kalshi.description: Include posts with a Kalshi ticker, optionally limited to kalshiTickers

kalshiTickers.description: Kalshi tickers to limit kalshi matches to; applies only with kalshi: true

polymarket.description: Include posts matched to Polymarket markets, optionally limited to polymarketMarketIds

polymarketMarketIds.description: Polymarket market IDs to limit polymarket matches to; applies only with polymarket: true

widenWithHighlights.description: Also include posts matching the collection’s enabled highlight rules; applies only when crypto, polymarket or kalshi is true

nextToken.description: nextToken from the previous page, with the other arguments unchanged; omit for the first page

name: get_collection_posts

matchAiFilter.description: null when the collection has no AI filter. Stored posts are not AI-evaluated, so false does not mean the filter rejected the post

title: Read collection posts
